headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low after Friday’s two-sided rebound
body: Friday ended with two-sided Nasdaq price discovery. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no fresh extension or failed-retracement structure can be observed; rates, oil and Hormuz remain Stress inputs.
